summary: Hardware diagnostic research profile. Candidate features: pad,encoder,button,usb,display,audio. Software: MASCHINE.
identityNotes: Research seed; MASCHINE MK3 has manufacturer-documented USB audio routing with two input channels, main outputs 1/2 and headphone outputs 3/4, plus 24-bit conversion. The Getting Started guide's 2.7.7 (07/2018) version refers to software, not qualified firmware. Individual sample rates, hardware revision, OS support, firmware, USB IDs, class compliance, MIDI/HID maps and physical performance remain unverified. No factory tolerances or physical qualification are claimed. Transport addendum (2026-11-18): MASCHINE MK3 Getting Started 2.7.7, section 2.3.5, p. 30 and p. 31: separate 5-pin DIN IN and OUT connect external MIDI equipment. Activate the ports in MIDI Preferences for standalone software, or configure the host for plug-in use. USB MIDI remains unresolved.

documents.title: MASCHINE MK3 product features and audio interface specifications
documents.notes: Checked 2026-11-18. Exact MK3 hardware: 24-bit audio interface with a 96 kHz maximum. This does not enumerate all supported hardware sample rates.

documents.title: MASCHINE MK3 Getting Started, software 2.7.7
documents.notes: Checked 2026-11-18. Document identifies software 2.7.7 (07/2018) and MASCHINE MK3 hardware. Section 2.1, printed pp. 17-18, covers USB computer connection; section 2.2.1, p. 21, routes inputs L/R to 1/2, main outputs to 1/2 and headphones to 3/4. The software/document version is not a firmware qualification.

documents.title: Notes on MASCHINE MK3's audio interface
documents.notes: Checked 2026-11-18; no article revision identified. Connecting a microphone disables the line inputs; they are not simultaneous independent input channels. Main and headphone playback are separately addressable.

documents.title: MIDI/HID map
documents.notes: Exact implementation mapping not verified; use learn mode and capture.

documents.title: Native Instruments MASCHINE MK3 Getting Started — 2.7.7 (MASCHINE MK3 MIDI scope)
documents.notes: Transport evidence only. 2.7.7; p. 30; p. 31. Exact MASCHINE MK3 DIN IN and OUT. The 2.7.7 document/software edition is not a firmware qualification. USB MIDI remains unresolved.

specs.label: Candidate hardware test groups
specs.notes: Model-dependent test planner; not exact control count or specification.

specs.label: USB audio input channels
specs.notes: MASCHINE MK3 input channels 1/2 are the left/right pair; the microphone and line-input paths share this pair. Software version 2.7.7 (07/2018) identifies the guide, not qualified firmware.

specs.label: USB audio output channels
specs.notes: The selected MASCHINE MK3 audio device routes main left/right to 1/2 and headphone left/right to 3/4. MASCHINE software's virtual output buses do not establish additional hardware channels.

specs.label: Documented DIN MIDI transport
specs.notes: MASCHINE MK3 Getting Started 2.7.7, section 2.3.5, p. 30 and p. 31: separate 5-pin DIN IN and OUT connect external MIDI equipment. Activate the ports in MIDI Preferences for standalone software, or configure the host for plug-in use. USB MIDI remains unresolved.
